title: OS command execution via system (matlab) — review required
description: The matlab sink system launches processes. Untrusted input in the command becomes command injection. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms arguments are trusted or passed as vectors via system with quoted, validated input.
remediation: Use system with quoted, validated input with separate arguments, never interpolated command strings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any system call matches. Other languages' launchers are separate rules.
